---
title: "Rule workbench"
subtitle: "Tune a rule's orb and window on the exploration period, and see what the data says as you move them"
description: "Evaluate a registered rule on the explore-period daily sky, with a live rate ratio, exact interval, circular-shift null, Molchan point and an overlay of events against the rule's windows."
---

::: {.af-banner #wb-banner}
You are tuning on the exploration period only; confirmation runs once, by a
maintainer, on data this page does not contain.
:::

Every study splits its time axis once, in its pre-registration, into an
exploration period and a confirmation period (ADR-003). This page holds the
exploration days only: the sidereal sky of each day, the Moon's tithi and
nakshatra, and which days had an event. Pick a study and a rule, move its
sliders, and the page re-evaluates the rule on every day, in your browser,
with the same statistics the studies use.

::: {.af-howto}
**How to read this.** The rate ratio compares how often events happen while
the rule (and its window) holds with how often they happen otherwise: 1 means
no difference, 1.3 means 30% more often. The interval is the exact 95%
interval under a Poisson process; it is too narrow when events cluster, so the
test is the circular-shift null beside it: the rule's on/off pattern is slid
against the fixed event days 500 times by at least the study's minimum shift,
and the p-value is the share of slides that do at least as well. The Molchan
point puts the rule on the alarm-versus-miss plane: on the diagonal it does no
better than chance. Each slider move is one more look at the same data, so a
striking number after many moves is expected by chance; that is why the
verdict comes from the confirmation period, which is not here. Only rules
whose conditions the browser can evaluate are listed (conjunction or
separation within an orb, planet in sign, house or kendra from another planet,
retrograde, tithi or paksha, nakshatra group, dasha lord).
:::

```{ojs}
core = import(new URL("../components/workbench-core.mjs", document.baseURI).href)
rulesData = FileAttachment("../data/rules.json").json()
wbFiles = ({
  earthquake: FileAttachment("../data/workbench_earthquake.json"),
  gold: FileAttachment("../data/workbench_gold.json"),
  silver: FileAttachment("../data/workbench_silver.json")
})
DEFAULT_RULE = ({ earthquake: "seismic.mangal_shani_malefic", gold: "financial.jupiter_retrograde_contraction",
  silver: "financial.jupiter_retrograde_contraction" })
STUDY_DOMAIN = ({ earthquake: ["seismic", "mundane"], gold: ["financial"], silver: ["financial"] })
```

::: {.af-filters}

```{ojs}
viewof studyKey = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Earthquakes (Himalayan arc)", "earthquake"], ["Gold", "gold"], ["Silver", "silver"]]),
  { label: "Study", value: "earthquake" })
```

```{ojs}
wb = wbFiles[studyKey].json()
cols = core.decode(wb)
viewof eventKey = Inputs.select(new Map(wb.events.map((k) => [wb.event_labels[k], k])),
  { label: "Events", value: wb.events.includes("ev_gk") ? "ev_gk" : wb.events[0] })
```

```{ojs}
usesDasha = (r) => JSON.stringify(r.machine).includes("dasha_lord_is")
evaluable = rulesData.rules
  .filter((r) => r.client_evaluable && (!usesDasha(r) || wb.dasha[r.id]))
  .sort((a, b) => (STUDY_DOMAIN[studyKey].includes(b.domain) - STUDY_DOMAIN[studyKey].includes(a.domain)) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
viewof ruleId = Inputs.select(new Map(evaluable.map((r) => [`${r.name} (v${r.version})`, r.id])),
  { label: "Rule", value: DEFAULT_RULE[studyKey] })
```

```{ojs}
rule = evaluable.find((r) => r.id === ruleId)
viewof alternative = Inputs.radio(["greater", "two-sided", "less"], {
  label: "Direction tested",
  value: ({ increase: "greater", up: "greater", decrease: "less", down: "less" })[rule.expected_effect?.direction] || wb.alternative_default
})
```

:::

```{ojs}
function orbOf(node) {
  return node.pred ? node.params.orb : node.of.map(orbOf).find((x) => x != null);
}
```

```{ojs}
// Sliders come from the rule's schema-v2 `params` (value, min, max, step,
// unit); rules.json says which condition slots ("$orb") or window ends each
// one drives. A rule without `params` gets sliders derived here from its
// conditions (the orb of its conjunction or separation leaves) and its window,
// and the page says so under the sliders.
knobs = {
  if (rule.params && Object.keys(rule.params).length) return { derived: false, specs: Object.entries(rule.params) };
  const specs = [];
  const orb = orbOf(rule.machine);
  if (orb != null) specs.push(["orb", { value: orb, min: 1, max: Math.min(30, Math.max(12, 2 * orb)), step: 1, unit: "deg" }]);
  const after = rule.window_days?.after ?? 0, before = rule.window_days?.before ?? 0;
  specs.push(["window_after", { value: Math.round(after), min: 0, max: Math.max(30, Math.ceil(2 * after)), step: 1, unit: "days" }]);
  if (before > 0) specs.push(["window_before", { value: Math.round(before), min: 0, max: Math.max(30, Math.ceil(2 * before)), step: 1, unit: "days" }]);
  return { derived: true, specs };
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof knobValues = {
  const form = Inputs.form(Object.fromEntries(knobs.specs.map(([k, s]) => [k,
    Inputs.range([s.min, s.max], { step: s.step || 1, value: s.value, label: `${k.replace("_", " ")} (${s.unit || ""})` })])));
  form.id = "wb-knobs";
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
htl.html`<p class="af-caption">${knobs.derived
  ? "This rule has no published tuning ranges yet, so the sliders are derived from its conditions and its window; the published value is where each slider starts."
  : "Slider ranges are the rule's published params; nothing else in the rule is tunable."}
  Strength terms, if any, are not evaluated here; the rule is treated as on or off.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
// Window ends in days: from the param that drives them, else the rule's window.
windowDays = (end) => {
  if (knobs.derived) return knobValues[`window_${end}`] ?? 0;
  const hit = Object.entries(rule.param_links || {}).find(([, l]) => l.targets.includes(`window_${end}`));
  return hit ? knobValues[hit[0]] * hit[1].days_per_unit : (rule.window_days?.[end] ?? 0);
}
dashaCtx = wb.dasha[rule.id] ? { dasha: core.dashaLevels(cols, wb.dasha[rule.id].runs) } : {}
raw = core.evaluate(knobs.derived ? rule.machine : (rule.machine_template ?? rule.machine), cols, dashaCtx, knobValues, knobs.derived)
ind = core.dilate(raw, cols.dayNum, windowDays("before"), windowDays("after"))
ev = core.eventBins(cols.events[eventKey])
onCount = ind.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
result = (onCount === 0 || onCount === cols.n || ev.length === 0) ? null
  : { ...core.shiftTest(ev, ind, wb.min_shift, 500, 42, alternative), molchan: core.molchanPoint(ind, ev) }
fmt = (x, d = 2) => (x == null || !Number.isFinite(x) ? "n/a" : x.toFixed(d))
fmtP = (p) => (p < 0.001 ? p.toExponential(1) : p.toFixed(3))
```

```{ojs}
readout = {
  if (!result) return htl.html`<div id="wb-readout" class="af-notice">The rule is ${onCount ? "on every" : "never on in this period on any"} ${wb.unit};
    no comparison is possible. Move a slider or pick another rule.</div>`;
  const e = result.exact;
  const pExact = alternative === "greater" ? e.pGreater : alternative === "two-sided" ? e.pTwoSided : null;
  return htl.html`<div class="af-status" id="wb-readout">
    <div class="af-status-item"><h4 class="af-readout-value" id="wb-rr">${fmt(e.rateRatio)}</h4>
      <span class="af-status-state">Rate ratio, 95% CI ${fmt(e.ciLow)} to ${fmt(e.ciHigh)} (exact, Poisson)</span></div>
    <div class="af-status-item"><h4 class="af-readout-value">${fmtP(result.pValue)}</h4>
      <span class="af-status-state">Circular-shift p (${alternative}), ${result.nDraws} draws, shift at least ${wb.min_shift} ${wb.unit}s;
        null median ${fmt(result.nullMedian)}${pExact == null ? "" : htl.html`; Poisson p ${fmtP(pExact)}`}</span></div>
    <div class="af-status-item"><h4 class="af-readout-value">${e.nIn} of ${ev.length}</h4>
      <span class="af-status-state">Events in the rule's windows, which cover ${(100 * e.tIn / cols.n).toFixed(1)}% of ${cols.n.toLocaleString()} ${wb.unit}s</span></div>
    <div class="af-status-item"><h4 class="af-readout-value">${fmt(result.molchan.tau)}, ${fmt(result.molchan.nu)}</h4>
      <span class="af-status-state">Molchan point (share of time on alarm, share of events missed); chance is the sum 1</span></div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
runs = runsOf(cols.dates.map((d) => new Date(d + "T00:00:00Z")), Array.from(ind))
eventDays = cols.dates.flatMap((d, i) => (cols.events[eventKey][i] > 0
  ? [{ date: new Date(d + "T12:00:00Z"), n: cols.events[eventKey][i], inside: ind[i] === 1 }] : []))
LANES = ["Rule window", "Event days"]
overlay = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1200));
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: 190, marginLeft: 96, marginRight: 16, style: plotStyle,
    x: { type: "utc", label: null, domain: [new Date(wb.explore.start), new Date(wb.explore.end)] },
    y: { domain: LANES, label: null, padding: 0.25 },
    color: { type: "identity" },
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(runs, { x1: (d) => d[0], x2: (d) => d[1], y: () => LANES[0], fill: palette.active, fillOpacity: 0.55,
        title: (d) => `Rule window ${d[0].toISOString().slice(0, 10)} to ${d[1].toISOString().slice(0, 10)}` }),
      Plot.tickX(eventDays, { x: "date", y: () => LANES[1], stroke: (d) => (d.inside ? palette.active : palette.inactive),
        strokeWidth: 2, title: (d) => `${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}: ${d.n} event${d.n > 1 ? "s" : ""}, ${d.inside ? "inside" : "outside"} the rule's window`, tip: true })
    ]
  });
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="wb-overlay">${plot}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
swatchLegend([{ color: palette.active, label: "Rule window, and events inside it" }, { color: palette.inactive, label: "Events outside the rule's window" }])
```

```{ojs}
nullCharts = {
  if (!result) return htl.html`<span></span>`;
  const half = Math.max(300, Math.min(width / 2 - 16, 580));
  const finite = result.nullRR.filter(Number.isFinite);
  const hist = Plot.plot({
    width: half, height: 250, marginLeft: 48, marginBottom: 42, style: plotStyle,
    x: { label: "Rate ratio under the circular-shift null" }, y: { label: "Draws", grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(finite, Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { x: (d) => d, fill: palette.inactive, inset: 1, rx: 2, tip: true })),
      Plot.ruleX([1], { stroke: palette.axis, strokeDasharray: "4,3" }),
      Plot.ruleX([result.exact.rateRatio], { stroke: palette.ink, strokeWidth: 2 }),
      Plot.text([result.exact.rateRatio], { x: (d) => d, frameAnchor: "top", dy: -4, text: () => "observed", fill: palette.ink, textAnchor: "start", dx: 4 }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: palette.axis })
    ]
  });
  const m = result.molchan;
  const mol = Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(half, 300), height: 250, marginLeft: 48, marginBottom: 42, marginRight: 16, style: plotStyle,
    x: { domain: [0, 1], label: "Share of time on alarm (tau)", grid: true }, y: { domain: [0, 1], label: "Share of events missed (nu)", grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.line([[0, 1], [1, 0]], { stroke: palette.axis, strokeDasharray: "4,3" }),
      Plot.dot([m], { x: "tau", y: "nu", r: 6, fill: palette.active, stroke: palette.surface, strokeWidth: 2,
        title: (d) => `tau ${d.tau.toFixed(3)}, nu ${d.nu.toFixed(3)}`, tip: true })
    ]
  });
  return htl.html`<div class="af-grid-2"><div class="af-chart" id="wb-null">${hist}</div><div class="af-chart" id="wb-molchan">${mol}</div></div>`;
}
```

## What is published for this rule

The tuning log is written by `astro-rules fit` and the stamp by
`astro-rules confirm`, once per rule version. Both are shown read-only.

```{ojs}
REPO_BLOB = "https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/blob/main/"
published = {
  const v = rule.validation;
  const log = rule.tuning_log || [];
  const reviews = rule.review || [];
  const row = (k, x) => (x == null ? "" : htl.html`<tr><td>${k}</td><td><code>${typeof x === "object" ? JSON.stringify(x) : x}</code></td></tr>`);
  return htl.html`<div class="af-drawer" id="wb-published">
    <h3>${rule.name}</h3>
    <p><code>${rule.id}</code> · version ${rule.version} · ${rule.tier} · <a href=${REPO_BLOB + rule.path}>YAML file</a></p>
    <p>${stamp(rule.validation_state)}</p>
    ${v && v.confirm ? htl.html`<table class="table af-table"><tbody>${row("study", v.study)}${row("confirm rate ratio", v.confirm.rate_ratio)}
      ${row("confirm CI", v.confirm.ci)}${row("confirm p", v.confirm.p)}${row("family q", v.confirm.q_family)}${row("at", v.at)}${row("commit", v.commit)}</tbody></table>` : ""}
    <p>${rule.claim}</p>
    <details><summary>Tuning log (${log.length} ${log.length === 1 ? "entry" : "entries"})</summary>
      ${log.length ? htl.html`<table class="table af-table"><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>By</th><th>Study</th><th>Chosen</th><th>Explore result</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${log.map((t) => htl.html`<tr><td>${t.at}</td><td>${t.by}</td><td>${t.study}</td><td><code>${JSON.stringify(t.chosen)}</code></td>
        <td><code>${JSON.stringify(t.explore)}</code></td></tr>`)}</tbody></table>`
        : htl.html`<p class="af-notice">No tuning published yet for this rule.</p>`}
    </details>
    <details><summary>Reviews (${reviews.length})</summary>
      ${reviews.length ? htl.html`<ul>${reviews.map((r) => htl.html`<li><strong>${r.verdict}</strong> by ${r.by} (${r.at})${r.note ? `: ${r.note}` : ""}</li>`)}</ul>`
        : htl.html`<p class="af-notice">No review of this rule's operationalisation yet.</p>`}
    </details>
  </div>`;
}
```

## Submit this tuning

The button opens a prefilled "Propose a rule" issue with the parameters you
chose and the exploration result. A maintainer turns it into a new rule
version and runs `astro-rules fit` on it; the confirmation run comes after,
once.

```{ojs}
tuningYaml = {
  const e = result?.exact;
  const lines = [
    "# Tuning proposed from the rule workbench (exploration period only)",
    `rule: ${rule.id}`,
    `from_version: ${rule.version}`,
    `study: ${wb.study}`,
    `events: ${eventKey}`,
    "params:",
    ...knobs.specs.map(([k, s]) => `  ${k}: {value: ${knobValues[k]}, min: ${s.min}, max: ${s.max}, step: ${s.step || 1}, unit: ${s.unit || "none"}}`),
    "explore:",
    `  period: [${wb.explore.start}, ${wb.explore.end}]`,
    `  rate_ratio: ${fmt(e?.rateRatio, 3)}`,
    `  ci: [${fmt(e?.ciLow, 3)}, ${fmt(e?.ciHigh, 3)}]`,
    `  p_shift: ${result ? result.pValue.toFixed(4) : "n/a"}  # ${alternative}, 500 draws, min shift ${wb.min_shift} ${wb.unit}s`,
    `  n_in: ${e?.nIn ?? "n/a"}`,
    `  t_in: ${e?.tIn ?? "n/a"}`,
    `  molchan: {tau: ${fmt(result?.molchan.tau, 4)}, nu: ${fmt(result?.molchan.nu, 4)}}`,
    `  window_days: {before: ${windowDays("before").toFixed(2)}, after: ${windowDays("after").toFixed(2)}}`,
    `  slider_ranges_derived: ${knobs.derived}`
  ];
  return lines.join("\n");
}
issueUrl = {
  const u = new URL("https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/issues/new");
  const q = {
    template: "propose-rule.yml",
    title: `[Rule]: tuning of ${rule.id} (v${rule.version} -> v${rule.version + 1})`,
    name: `${rule.name} (tuned)`,
    claim: rule.claim,
    domain: rule.domain,
    source_text: rule.source,
    tier: rule.tier,
    conditions: tuningYaml,
    window: `${windowDays("before").toFixed(1)} days before to ${windowDays("after").toFixed(1)} days after`,
    expected_effect: rule.expected_effect ? Object.values(rule.expected_effect).join(" / ") : "",
    fires_on: `Unchanged: see the reference cases in ${rule.path}`
  };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(q)) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
  return u.href;
}
htl.html`<p><a class="btn btn-primary" id="wb-submit" href=${issueUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener">Submit this tuning</a></p>
  <details><summary>The YAML that goes into the issue</summary><pre><code>${tuningYaml}</code></pre></details>`
```
